# gzcoord-operator

An operator tree for `tests/test_gzcoord_protocol.py` (ADR-045 §5 rule 3:
tests read instance fixtures, never this checkout's live instance
files): the role catalogue cut to the roles the suite and the protocol's
examples name, titles and groups as the catalogue had them on
2026-10-08, and gzapp's GZCoord integration. A case or an example that
comes to name another role fails until it is added here.
